search.description:
No IQOS devices were found yet. Put one IQOS near the Bluetooth proxy, make it connectable, then choose **Search again**.

Pairing guide:

IQOS ILUMA i / ILUMA i PRIME: place the holder in the pocket charger, hold the main button for about 5 seconds to turn it off, then hold it again for about 5 seconds to turn it on. Wait for the lights to pulse or blink.

IQOS ILUMA i ONE / ILUMA ONE: hold the ON/OFF button for about 4-5 seconds until the status lights turn on or pulse. If it was already on and not found, restart it by holding the button for about 10 seconds, then turn it on again.

IQOS ILUMA / ILUMA PRIME: place the holder in the charger, turn the device off by holding the main button for about 5 seconds, then turn it on again by holding it for about 5 seconds. Wait for pulsing lights.

Older IQOS models with a Bluetooth button: press the Bluetooth button for about 3 seconds until the Bluetooth status light blinks.

pairing_guide.description:
Start with **Search Bluetooth devices**. Home Assistant will scan through your Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy only after you press Search.

Pairing guide:

IQOS ILUMA i / ILUMA i PRIME: place the holder in the pocket charger, hold the main button for about 5 seconds to turn it off, then hold it again for about 5 seconds to turn it on. Wait for the lights to pulse or blink.

IQOS ILUMA i ONE / ILUMA ONE: hold the ON/OFF button for about 4-5 seconds until the status lights turn on or pulse. If it was already on and not found, restart it by holding the button for about 10 seconds, then turn it on again.

IQOS ILUMA / ILUMA PRIME: place the holder in the charger, turn the device off by holding the main button for about 5 seconds, then turn it on again by holding it for about 5 seconds. Wait for pulsing lights.

Older IQOS models with a Bluetooth button: press the Bluetooth button for about 3 seconds until the Bluetooth status light blinks.

Keep only one IQOS in pairing/connectable mode while adding it.
pairing_guide.title: Set up IQOS

bluetooth_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant does not currently have a connectable Bluetooth scanner available. IQOS needs an active BLE/GATT connection, so a passive-only Bluetooth proxy is not enough.

Check this first:

1. Your ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online in Home Assistant.
2. The proxy YAML has `bluetooth_proxy.active: true`.
3. The Bluetooth integration shows the proxy under **Settings > Devices & services > Bluetooth**.
4. Restart the ESPHome proxy and Home Assistant if the proxy was just added.

After fixing Bluetooth, choose **Check Bluetooth again**. You can still enter a Bluetooth address manually, but the integration will not connect until a connectable Bluetooth proxy is available.
bluetooth_unavailable.title: Bluetooth proxy not ready
